title: Physical Intelligence Negotiates $1B Round at $20B Valuation
summary:
Physical Intelligence is negotiating a new funding round of more than $1 billion that would value the robotics AI startup at approximately $20 billion. The investment is being co-led by venture capital firms Avenir and Lux Capital.

The potential valuation is nearly double the $11.5 billion valuation the company reached in an earlier round in 2026, and represents a steep increase from $5.6 billion in November 2025. The company recently expanded its capabilities on Oct. 13 with the launch of the Pi API beta, which allows a waitlisted group of developers to use hosted fine-tuning and inference for its robotic models.

selectedTweets.text:
Bloomberg: Physical Intelligence is in talks to raise at least $1B at roughly $20B, nearly double the $11.5B valuation from its earlier 2026 round.

Its valuation has climbed from $2.4B in November 2024 to $5.6B in November 2025, and the new round would roughly quadruple that figure in under a year.

The latest jump followed the October 13 Pi API beta, which gives outside developers hosted fine-tuning and inference on the company’s latest robot models through a waitlist.
